LanguageData.VRESaurids_ColdBlooded.description: Carriers of this gene need to maintain a steady body temperature. Being too hot or too cold will result in loss of motor functions, and if unchecked too long - death.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_ColdBlooded.label: cold-blooded
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Oviparous.description: Carriers of this gene lay eggs instead of giving live birth. Eggs need time and correct conditions to hatch.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Oviparous.label: oviparous
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Pheromones.description: Carriers of this gene excrete special pheromones that attract members of the same xenotype.
LanguageData.VRESaurids_Pheromones.label: pheromones
